description: This file defines the EmployeeDependentDao class, which handles data access operations related to employee dependents within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching dependents based on various criteria, interacting with the ORM and database layer.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class responsible for CRUD operations and searches related to employee dependents in the system.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Retrieves all dependents for a specified employee, ordered by name.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Fetches a specific dependent for an employee based on employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getExistingDependentIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns sequence numbers of dependents that exist for a given employee and list of IDs.

methods.name: saveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Saves or updates a dependent, assigning a sequence number if not provided, with validation.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Deletes specified dependents for an employee based on sequence numbers.

methods.name: searchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Performs a search for dependents based on filter parameters and returns the matched records.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeDependentPaginator
methods.description: Creates and configures a paginator object for searching dependents with sorting and filters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeDependentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of dependents matching search filters.
